issue.title: Require explicit bead decisions when creating stitches
issue.description: Prevent commits from closing unfinished beads by requiring an explicit close or keep decision for bead-associated stitch creation, including host finalization and checkpoint recovery.

issue.title: Shared bead decision contract
issue.description: core_contract: add a strict Rust bead-action policy and Python bindings, plus authenticated finalizer context for the assigned bead.

issue.title: Enforce and carry the decision through every commit path
issue.description: integrate_policy: replace the opt-out CLI, enforce preflight and resume rules, carry declared choices through host finalization, and migrate callers, skill sources, documentation, and focused tests together.

issue.title: Verify lifecycle and recovery across the integrated system
issue.description: verify_lifecycle: exercise real phase and task beads with local commit remotes, test interrupted close recovery and declaration propagation, and fix integration defects before landing.

payload.entry:
Exported API for integrate_policy (sase-zq.2):

sase-core bead_action contract (schema_version=1), unused until Python callers switch:
- parse_bead_action_field(payload) -> Optional[close|keep]; omitted key is None; rejects boolean/null/empty/unknown and any do_not_close_bead key with migration text "use -B keep or -B close"
- decide_bead_action / decide_bead_action_from_json: host facts assigned_bead_id, commit_method (create_commit|create_pull_request|create_proposal), repository_scope (primary|linked|external|sdd|unknown), primary_repository_identified, bead_action, bead_status (in_progress|closed|other|unreadable|unchecked)
- dispositions: keep, close (close_bead=true), close_idempotent, unassociated
- keep never requires status lookup; close requires identified primary + create_commit/create_pull_request + in_progress or closed; failed primary lookup does not grant close; proposal close is rejected
- validate_finalizer_bead_decision(context, decision) and validate_finalizer_assigned_bead_binding(context, expected)

FinalizerContextWire additive assigned_bead {bead_id, primary_repo_obligation_id?}; FINALIZER_WIRE_SCHEMA_VERSION stays 2; omitted association serializes identically and keeps the unassociated digest.

PyO3: bead_action_wire_schema_version, parse_bead_action_field, decide_bead_action, validate_finalizer_bead_decision, validate_finalizer_assigned_bead_binding.

Do not bump sase-core-rs>=0.34.0,<0.35.0 until release-plz publishes this API. No Python fallback.

Verified: sase-core fmt-check + clippy; cargo test --workspace (with LD_LIBRARY_PATH workaround for sase-xv) including bead_action policy table and PyO3 JSON/digest/assignment-mismatch tests; sase mypy+pytest on the additive FinalizerAssignedBeadWire converters.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: just check mypy fails in src/sase/llm_provider/continuation_budget.py:176 — _int_setting assigns config.get(key) (object) onto raw inferred as str | None from env.get; unrelated to bead-action, observed on a tree whose only sase edits are FinalizerAssignedBeadWire converters.

Added unused sase-core bead_action policy (schema 1) and additive FinalizerContextWire.assigned_bead (wire schema stays 2). Verified: core fmt-check+clippy; cargo test --workspace including UX-table policy tests and PyO3 JSON/digest/assignment-mismatch bindings (LD_LIBRARY_PATH workaround for sase-xv); sase mypy+pytest on FinalizerAssignedBeadWire converters. No CLI/workflow call sites switched yet.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: just check was red at lint (symvision) on clean trees because sase-zq.1 exported FinalizerAssignedBeadWire and finalizer_assigned_bead_from_dict for sase-zq.2 but closed without --epic-symbol. Reproduced 2026-09-12 on sase-zm.1 at master 9c2eb4a35: unused public symbols in src/sase/core/finalizer_wire.py. Re-keyed Justfile _lint-symvision to --epic-symbol sase-zq.2(...) so the still-open integrate_policy phase owns them. Drop those two entries when zq.2 (or a later zq phase) actually consumes them from another src file, or if they become private.

DISCOVERED ISSUE from sase-zm.1: Justfile _lint-symvision now whitelists FinalizerAssignedBeadWire and finalizer_assigned_bead_from_dict as --epic-symbol sase-zq.2(...). sase-zq.1 exported them for this phase and closed without the whitelist, which made just check red repo-wide. Consume them from a non-test src caller or drop the Justfile entries when they are no longer public-without-consumer.

Implemented explicit bead_action enforcement through stitch, resume, finalizer declarations, docs, skills, and tests. Verified: sase bead epic-symbols sase-zq.2 (no entries); just check (passed, scoped lane escalated to full suite due packaging-config).

Added and verified explicit bead-action lifecycle coverage: real subprocess stitch flow rejects missing action, keep leaves the phase in progress, close closes only the assigned phase; finalizer context rejects unset bead_action and threads authored keep into stitch attempts. Verified with focused pytest and just check.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (sase-11r land agent, 2026-09-16): 'sase final submit' refuses every repository decision with bead_action "close" unless the agent hand-writes a bead_status fact, even though the bead is readable. _validate_commit_decision (src/sase/finalizers/declaration_manifest.py) passes the manifest decision straight into validate_finalizer_bead_decision. Its bead_action_request_for_decision (sase-core bead_action/policy.rs) copies decision.bead_status, which is None because the /sase_final manifest_template has no bead_status field and submit never calls bead_status_fact(). decide_bead_action then maps None to unreadable_bead_status ('the assigned bead status could not be read; close is refused'). Evidence: final_submission_attempts.jsonl across ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202609 records 135 such refusals from 2026-09-12T16:08:33Z (just after df33453b7f 'require explicit bead action') through 2026-09-16T21:39:53Z. Of 958 accepted September repository decisions, only 1 used close (20260912161215, which supplied bead_status: closed by hand). Everyone else falls back to keep; for example, sase-11r.2 was refused at 18:09:21Z and resubmitted keep at 18:09:45Z, and this land run was refused for a bead that 'sase bead show --format json' reports as closed. Impact: the documented '/sase_final close' path is dead, so agents must close beads by hand and the host close never runs. Suggested fix: have submit read the live status (bead_status_fact for the primary repo) before validating, or defer the status check to the post-commit close where commit_dispatch_followup already reads it.

DISCOVERED ISSUE (update, 2026-09-23): the submit-time close refusal in note #2 is still live on master 09dda64b5. ace-run final_submission_attempts.jsonl now records 370 unreadable_bead_status refusals (2026-09-12T16:08:33Z..2026-09-24T00:35:39Z), 235 of them after note #2. Latest: sase-17d.1 (run 20260923191831, refused 23:35:28Z, bead already closed by hand, so a host status read would have allowed close_idempotent) and sase-17d.2--code (run 20260923193002, refused 2026-09-24T00:07:56Z). Both resubmitted keep. The only accepted close declarations (5 in September) all hand-wrote bead_status: closed. Code path unchanged: declaration_manifest._validate_commit_decision -> validate_finalizer_bead_decision -> policy.rs decide_close maps bead_status None to unreadable_bead_status.

Fixed submit-time unreadable_bead_status (notes #2/#3) by having the host read the live bead status in declaration_manifest (_assigned_bead_status/_host_close_bead_status via bead_status_fact) and threading host_records through validate_provider_payloads in declaration.py and commit_declaration.py. New tests: tests/test_finalizer_declaration_bead_close_status.py (11 cases: in_progress/closed accept, other/unreadable/raises refuse, host-fact-wins, keep/no-bead/non-primary/missing-record, reload) plus live close e2e in tests/test_finalizers_live_e2e.py.

Submit-time unreadable_bead_status defect from notes #2/#3 is fixed: declaration_manifest now drops any agent-authored bead_status and sets the host-read live status (via bead_status_fact at the primary repo's host-recorded path) for primary-repository close decisions across all three validation paths (submit, currency check, accepted-declaration load). New tests: tests/test_finalizer_declaration_bead_close_status.py (10 cases) plus a live close e2e in tests/test_finalizers_live_e2e.py. Targeted suites green (106 passed). just check still red on a pre-existing symvision private-import failure present on the clean tree (usage/_refresh_*, _presentation_* etc. from the recent split); unrelated to this change. Status untouched; land assignee owns it.
